description: "History of the United Netherlands, 1588" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account that falls within the genre of history writing, specifically focusing on the political landscape and events of the Netherlands during the late 16th century. Written in the mid to late 19th century, the book examines the period surrounding the Dutch struggle for independence from Spanish rule, detailing the complex interactions and conflicts involving prominent figures of that time, including the political machinations of England and the influence of Queen Elizabeth I.
